title: Grand Theft Auto VI — Trophy Guide & Tracker (PlayStation 5)

trophies.guide: The Platinum pops automatically the moment you earn the other 54 trophies — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in this guide (story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup) and it will unlock on its own. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours to the Platinum, with one playthrough enough and no online trophies. Sources: Exophase — official list (name, description, grade); PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (difficulty and time estimate).
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and finish it — the trophy pops at the end of the mission. This is the first mission of the game, so every player earns it within the first hour. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (automatic story trophy, first mission of Chapter 1).
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Before the chapter closes, do the one thing in the game that may be missable: the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning after the mission Down to Earth, follow her to the balcony and accept. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Chapter 1, missable meditation warning).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission of Chapter 2; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: after the mission Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and free-roam together, which unlocks the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and the character-specific questlines. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (no mission replay, manual saves, Coffee Break unlocks switching).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission of Chapter 3; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. During Chapter 3 several trophy systems unlock: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Snap Gun and jewelry robberies), Randy's Wish List and the Key Cloner, and the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check. Do the optional missions as they appear — they introduce new features and there are far more than the 100 the 100% checklist needs. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Chapter 3 unlocks).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every main mission of Chapter 4; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Chapter 4 is where the big robberies open up: the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… introduces large bank vault robberies, which also feed Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play and Hot Together. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Chapter 4 bank vault introduction).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the final story mission and the trophy pops at the credits. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so before the final mission, keep a manual save — the game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, and PowerPyx recommends a save at the start and end of each chapter. After the story you return to free-roam and everything needed for 100% is still available. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (final mission, free-roam after the story, manual saves).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Just follow the story — no special preparation or side objective is needed. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (automatic story trophy, Chapter 2 mission).
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is a story heist, so simply play through it — no side content is required first. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (automatic story trophy, Chapter 3 mission).
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission Child's Play in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Play through the story normally and it unlocks by itself. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (automatic story trophy, Chapter 4 mission).
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission Headliners in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops when the mission ends. No preparation needed — it is part of the main story path. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (automatic story trophy, Chapter 4 mission).
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops when the mission ends. The mission takes place at Vice City International Airport — the same airport where the Catch Me If You Can trophy's plane theft happens in free-roam. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (automatic story trophy, Chapter 4 mission).
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is one of the last story missions, so by the time you earn it you will be close to the endgame cleanup phase. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (automatic story trophy, Chapter 5 mission).
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the last one most players earn. The 100% Completion Checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts toward it. The requirements are lenient: PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% true completion, most side quests are not required, and you only need 70 of the 80 challenges. The only tasks that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Practical targets from the checklist: any 100 optional missions, scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals with binoculars, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations. Nothing toward 100% is missable — everything can be done in free-roam after the story. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (100% checklist, lenient thresholds); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress targets).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four categories: 130 Stunt Jumps (ramps), 202 Under the Bridges (fly under bridges), 40 Knife Flights (fly between buildings) and 25 Base Jumps (parachute). Mix categories freely — PowerPyx calls Under the Bridges the quickest. Track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and find stunt spots on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots; each completed stunt stays marked. For the 100% checklist you need 300 stunts, so keep going past 250. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (250 of 397, category counts, tracking); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once — the trophy tracker counts 9 types, viewable under Touchpad, Progress, Activities. The types are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt. Most are introduced by the story or marked on the map with the blue dumbbell icon, and you will do one of each naturally while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (9 activity types, where to view them).
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting range locations. Gold medals are not very difficult, according to PowerPyx — take your time, use a steady aim, and replay any challenge you miss gold on; ranges stay available after the story. The shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (12 locations, 42 gold medals); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target).
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total — each location has several races, but one win per location is enough for the trophy). Drone races are marked on the map once you unfog the area; fly the course cleanly and learn each track's turns before pushing for the win. For the 100% checklist you need all 42 races, so this trophy is a step toward that. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (14 locations, 42 races).
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins, not 20 wins at the same track. There are 40 unique race locations in total. Street races appear through the racing strands (Yago's strand in Chapter 3 is one route in), and race challenges and drone races also count toward the activity set. Pick a fast car you handle well, learn the route on a practice run, then race to win. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (40 unique race locations).
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he will send a text message marking a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline — fish at the marked spots and beat him in the fishing challenge when it comes up. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, and catching fish also raises your Focus level. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Cal's questline, text message, purple map icon).
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward; Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game once — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (4 games, where to play them).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia in Chapter 3 you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, marking the questline on the map in Belville. Complete all 5 Andy quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of her quests stay available after the story. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Lucia-only, Chapter 3, 5 quests, Belville).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. After the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls you, then he is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving: he marks purple treasure chest icons on the map, you dive to shipwrecks, dig up treasure with the metal detector and bring it back to him. Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his quest sets — after each set he calls you back to his shop and marks more. Track progress under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees and Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, so nothing is missable. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (7 shipwrecks, Key Lento, tracking menus).
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Complete all 5 Billy quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of his quests stay available after the story. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Chapter 2, Thrillbilly Mud Club, 5 quests).
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only certain questlines count — many optional questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie) do not count as strangers for this trophy. Confirmed counting strands from PowerPyx: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests — Skunk Apeology 101, Search for Tree Effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street racing strand — Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests and package deliveries). All stranger strands stay available after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count. Note: Yago's Race Against Yago is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so do it when it appears. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (which strands count); OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List (time-sensitive Yago race).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. Randy then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon in the west of Vice City). He marks some cars for you in fixed locations, but you can also steal them off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to check whether it is on his list, then drive it back in good condition for a better payout. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (16 cars, Key Cloner, RK icon, tracking).
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them (the quest Take Out Kitty Litter). After destroying enough labs Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finish it and the trophy pops. All of it stays available after the story. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Jason-only, Synthetic Labs, two quests).
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — read this before you finish Chapter 1. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Lucia and Jason at the same spot counts double, so you can finish faster once both characters are playable together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The danger: one meditation happens only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house and never comes back. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose Accept so she teaches you to meditate. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether that Chapter 1 meditation is required for the trophy, but its author earned the trophy after doing it — do it to be safe, and keep a manual save from Chapter 1. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so the trophy is stricter than the checklist. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 spots, Chapter 1 balcony meditation, unconfirmed requirement).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, and is exclusive to Jason — while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County. Bret then marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations; a clean one-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not mandatory. Track progress under Map, Activities, Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally along the way. Which exact animal unlocks it is still being confirmed. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Jason-only, Lummox County, Target Decks, unconfirmed animal).
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in total across Leonida, so you only need 3 of them — pick the sets whose cards you find first while exploring and follow a card guide for their locations. Cards are a collectible type, so check the in-game Collections menu to see which sets you have started. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 card sets); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly) and scan 100 locations: hold R1 while looking at a scannable object. There are far more than 100 — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures among them — so any 100 will do. Scan as you travel: landmarks in Vice City, curiosities out in the counties, and sculptures wherever you spot them. WAiNK scanning also feeds Whip It Good (scan vehicles) and Randy's Wish List (check sports cars). Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (100 locations, category counts, controls).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. View and track them under Progress, Challenges — a checkmark shows which are done. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so leave this for late in your run and then pick the easiest remaining ones. For the 100% checklist you need 70 of 80, so this trophy unlocks automatically on the way there. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (80 challenges, 70 needed for 100%).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level (cause carnage until the fourth star appears), then escape the red heat zone entirely; the trophy pops when you drive out of the heat area, not just out of the flashing search area. Easiest escape: a fast sports motorcycle through traffic, and if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. PowerPyx's recommended route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you there. It also unlocks automatically during the Chapter 4 bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars, so do not worry if it does not pop on your first try. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (partner call, train tunnel route, bank vault auto-unlock).
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. With your partner beside you (hold Right, press Triangle to call them), rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between robberies. Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the full red heat level. Gear up first: an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — loot a couple of items in each store, break the safe with sticky bombs if you can, and keep moving to the next. The unlock is delayed: it pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (partner, loadout, 3 jewelry stores, delayed pop).
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. The game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes), and for the 100% checklist you need to scan 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so this trophy comes automatically. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (557 vehicles, WAiNK scanning, 200 for 100%).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm — time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health. You must down 5 enemies in one use, and the window lasts only a few seconds. Prepare first: buff your focus with food and drinks or by washing your face and showering at home, and consume Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend Combat Focus. Line up 5 enemies before activating — criminals at gang operations are good targets, and the trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nations and use an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556 assault rifle. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Focus); it rises from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game and may pop naturally. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (controls, Adrenaline, Duke 556, Focus levels).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one parked out on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get in, go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly away. The unlock is delayed — you must fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport before it pops. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (E3/E4 terminals, 1 km distance).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino). They are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive in through the gate or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, get into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy wanted response, so go in with body armor and a plan to escape. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Mile Zero Air Station, south of the base).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies (marked with a green icon on unfogged map areas). Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun (the gadget stays in your inventory; at a locked door choose the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door, which triggers the alarm). Inside, go to the back room, find the note with the safe code, and loot the safe without being seen. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Snap Gun, back door, safe code, Richardson Jewelry).
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress — it teaches bank vault robbery. Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry a briefcase of cash in and open the vault, then go in fast and rob it; bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that mission, pay Yasmani — the fence unlocked in Chapter 3 — for security van tips ($10,000 each; finish his earlier Payday Loans robberies first), which mark vans with a purple icon. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; you need any 5 for this trophy, but all 8 for the 100% checklist, so it comes automatically. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. A single bank can pay up to $205,000. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (intro mission, Yasmani tips, 8 banks, $205,000).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the same mission that introduces bank vault robberies. Tailing the armored truck to a bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing an armored truck, so you will earn this while working on Maximum Withdrawal. For an earlier method: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani unlocks as a fence from Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). Either way, the trophy pops only after you escape the red heat radius — use a Pay 'n' Spray if needed. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (auto-unlock mission, sticky bomb method, escape the heat).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map — visit every area until no black fog is left on it. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every fogged region until the map is fully visible. The game tracks 52 areas, and a plane (available early, from Chapter 1) clears the fog fastest. Do this alongside Whip It Good and You WAiNKer!, since you will be travelling the whole map anyway. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (unfog by plane); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you get near them (many are also marked automatically from story progress). Track each gang under Progress, Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed. You only need 1 per gang for this trophy, but all 39 for the 100% checklist, so it comes automatically during cleanup. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (9 gangs, 39 operations, tracking).
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, so treat this as a best-effort plan from the description alone. Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City and look for a bar or cocktail spot with a view over the beach and ocean; order or enjoy a cocktail there. Try beachfront bars and hotel terraces along Ocean Drive, and check the spot again at different times of day if nothing triggers. Do not rely on any single unverified location — this entry will be updated as launch-era guides confirm the exact spot. Sources: Exophase — official list (name and description); PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method currently unknown).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, so treat this as a best-effort plan from the description alone. Find a vehicle showroom (a car dealership with a glass front) and drive a car straight through its front window to smash your way out, in the style of the classic GTA showroom escape. Try the showrooms in Vice City; if the first one does not trigger it, try another — the exact showroom is still being confirmed by launch-era guides. Sources: Exophase — official list (name and description); PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method currently unknown).
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the illegal gang operations (Kolt & Associates). Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first; you need them to blow the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, collect the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs) — each has a golden icon. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. It is not missable: if you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for the remaining valuables. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (3 valuables, locations, respawn).
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, select a character, scroll to Strength (heart icon). Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always go together with both characters (hold Right, press Triangle to call your partner): while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Filter for fitness clubs on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (max strength both characters, work out together).
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — PSN tracks the count to 500, viewable by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On): every time you do something that affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen. Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (large-scale killing) and Irredeemable — which is permanent, so avoid excessive violence if you do not want cops shooting you on sight forever. This will very likely complete passively while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist; every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If anything is left at the end, it can be farmed quickly, but keep the Irredeemable warning in mind. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (500 actions, profiles, Irredeemable warning); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (progress target).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. From the description alone, the pattern is a second attempt succeeding where the first failed: if a Payday Loans interaction or another early activity offers a retry, take the second chance and see it through. Treat this as an unconfirmed lead — launch-era guides are still pinning down the exact trigger, and this entry will be updated when it is confirmed. Sources: Exophase — official list (name and description); PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown, believed Payday Loans related).
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. From the description alone, expect a strange scripted encounter: keep an eye out for unusual lights or objects in the sky, especially at night in remote areas, and investigate any odd event the game flags. Treat this as an unconfirmed lead — the exact trigger is still being confirmed by launch-era guides, and this entry will be updated when it is. Sources: Exophase — official list (name and description); PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown, believed UFO questline).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. From the description alone: ride a motorcycle, get close to an enemy on foot, and attack with a melee kick from the bike to knock them over — a melee drive-by. Try it on lone enemies away from heavy police response until the exact trigger is confirmed by launch-era guides. Sources: Exophase — official list (name and description); PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (currently unknown, believed motorcycle melee kick).
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans to collect marked bills, and bring them to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 total counts across all robberies, not in one delivery. It comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist: bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but those only unlock after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Dye Pack Jammer, Yasmani, cumulative total).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types — the total is cumulative across every shop in the game. The fastest way is buying the most expensive things: guns at Ammu-Nations (24 stores), car mods at mod shops (14), and tattoos at tattoo studios (11), plus clothing (67 stores), footwear (17), hair and beauty salons (18), electronics (15) and Pay 'n' Sprays (19). This comes naturally if you gear up properly for the robbery trophies and buy garages and cars — just keep spending and the trophy pops at $100,000. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (fastest spending, shop counts).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are also 4 story-related garages, which do not count). The garages cost $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone; buy the garages through that app. A quick way to fund them is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. Buying garages also adds parking spots, which you need for On the Spot. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (8 garages, $160,000, Vice City Real Estate app).
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. To register 10 vehicles you first need enough garage space — buy garages (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds parking spots. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and Register. At first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down. Sources: Exophase — official list; PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Scooter Bros app, Moses, Respray and Register, cheap vehicles).
trophies.name: On the Spot
